([[Elk Grove, California]]) | college = [[Washington Huskies men's basketball|Washington]] (2015–2016) | draft_year = | draft_round = | draft_pick = | draft_team = | career_start = | years1 = | team1 = | highlights = }} '''Marquese Chriss''' (born July 2, 1997) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Washington Huskies men's basketball|Washington Huskies]]. Chriss attended [[Pleasant Grove High School (California)|Pleasant Grove High School]] in [[Elk Grove, California]]. He did not begin playing basketball until his freshman year in 2011 after a broken collarbone during middle school football caused his mother to bar him from playing.{{Cite web|url=http://www.seattletimes.com/sports/uw-husky-basketball/marquese-chriss-finds-his-comfort-zone-with-basketball-and-at-uw/|title=Marquese Chriss finds his comfort zone with basketball and at UW|date=2016-02-17|website=The Seattle Times|access-date=2016-06-21}} Despite this late start, he developed to be ranked as a Top 60 recruit in the Class of 2015.[http://www.nbadraft.net/players/marquese-chriss Marquese Chriss | NBADraft.net] As a freshman at the [[University of Washington]], he averaged 13.7 points and 5.4 rebounds per game.[http://www.bellinghamherald.com/sports/college/pac-12/university-of-washington/article67397722.html Marquese Chriss could be key to Huskies’ future — if he doesn’t go pro] He also wound up becoming the best freshman shot-blocker in Washington University's history with an average of 1.6 blocks per game and was an honorable mention for the Pac-12 All-Freshmen Team.[http://campusinsiders.com/news/marquese-chriss-nba-draft-profile-06-08-2016 A Marquese Chriss NBA Draft profile. The former Washington Husky forward is projected as high as a top 5 pick in the upcoming NBA Draft.] After the season, he entered the [[2016 NBA Draft]].[http://espn.go.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/15054665/marquese-chriss-dejounte-murray-washington-huskies-declaring-nba-draft Marquese Chriss, Dejounte Murray are one-and-done at Washington][http://www.seattletimes.com/sports/uw-husky-basketball/washingtons-dejounte-murray-and-marquese-chriss-declare-for-nba-draft/ Washington’s Dejounte Murray and Marquese Chriss declare for NBA draft] Before the draft began, Chriss would sign a multi-year endorsement deal with [[Nike, Inc.|Nike]].[http://sports.yahoo.com/news/sources--marquese-chriss-agrees-to-nike-deal-170147039.html Sources: Marquese Chriss agrees to Nike deal] Chriss is also compared favorably to both [[Amar'e Stoudemire]] and [[Shawn Kemp]] during their primes.http://www.nba.com/2016/news/features/scott_howard_cooper/06/21/2016-nba-mock-draft-3-0/ He is currently projected to be a Top 10 selection in the 2016 draft, with some websites projecting him as a Top 5 possibility. ==College career== ===College statistics=== {{NBA player statistics start}} |- | style="text-align:left;"| [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2015–16]] | style="text-align:left;"| [[2015–16 Washington Huskies men's basketball team|Washington]] | 34 || 34 || 24.9 || .530 || .350 || .685 || 5.4 || .8 || .9 || 1.6 || 13.8 |- {{S-end}} ==References== ==External links== *[http://www.gohuskies.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=30200&ATCLID=210174189 Washington Huskies bio] *[http://www.draftexpress.com/profile/Marquese-Chriss-83240/ DraftExpress Profile] {{DEFAULTSORT:Chriss, Marquese}} [[Category:1997 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:Basketball players from California]] [[Category:Power forwards (basketball)]] [[Category:Sportspeople from Sacramento, California]] [[Category:Washington Huskies men's basketball players]]
